Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.

Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics

Assistant Housekeeping Manager (m/f/x)Job DescriptionYour Focus: The well-being of guests and employees. You will assist with the coordination and management of the Housekeeping department.In addition, you will be responsible for:- Sharing responsibility for ordering and deliveries within the Housekeeping department- Collaborating with internal and external cleaning staff- Ensuring and implementing Motel One’s housekeeping standards, as well as being responsible for cleanliness in all areas- Sharing responsibility for conducting internal coaching sessions, cross-training, and onboarding new housekeeping employees- Gaining cross-departmental insights into new areas of work through collaboration in our multicultural teamsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you’re a seasoned hotel professional or looking to change careers—you’re a great fit for us! That’s because personality and hospitality skills are our top priorities! You also stand out because of:- Training in the hotel industry or professional experience in the hotel, restaurant, or retail sectors, or an interest in changing careers.- A passion for developing employees—ideally with some initial leadership experience- A strong focus on quality and service, as well as hospitality skills and a passion for the hotel industry- An open, communicative demeanor, good manners, and strong verbal and written communication skills in French and English.The ability to work well in a team and a willingness to provide cross-departmental support—we achieve our success together.

F&B ManagerJob DescriptionAs the F&B Manager at The Cloud One Hotels, you are entrusted with overseeing all F&B outlets. Alongside your team, you'll delight our guests with our locally sourced organic breakfast or the nightly "Sounds in the Clouds," featuring captivating beats at our bar. Your key responsibilities include:- Orchestrating, coordinating, and supervising operational workflows across our F&B outlets- Leadership and development of the F&B team, including recruitment, onboarding, skill enhancement, and ongoing educational initiatives- Collaborating on event planning and execution alongside our Guest Service Agent Events- Achieving revenue goals while managing cost budgets- Upholding hygiene standards and maintaining cleanliness in our F&B spaces- Building and managing relationships with local suppliers, in line with the Motel One Group's central procurement- Participation in the conception and design of our F&B offers- Enforcing workplace cleanliness and compliance with hygiene regulations- Collaborating seamlessly across departments and brandsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you're a professional in the hotel industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:- Experience in hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism, ideally within F&B- Passion for hospitality and team leadership- Strong commitment to quality and service excellence- Awareness of trends in gastronomy, events, and design- Proactive nature and eagerness to develop and implement innovative concepts (e.g., F&B offerings or events)- Entrepreneurial mindset, organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments

jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is us, your new colleaguesYou will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.This is the job- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location
• Stock counts
• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly
• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly
• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.
• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.

• You speak fluent Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.
• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.
• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks
